objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions that undergo creation, editing, review, release, and archiving.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type that documents regulations and instructions at a local or business process level.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, and responsible persons to achieve an objective.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type documenting detailed work steps and sub-processes such as test instructions with compliance criteria.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document, subject to versioning and triggering new versions of the main document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be deleted directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A document managed separately from the main document that proposes amendments without affecting content or version history.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person in the system assigned roles such as reader, author, reviewer, releaser, or translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned to perform specific roles or receive document distributions.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check whether a document should remain valid, be revised, or be invalidated.

objs.name: invalidation_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document out of force and archive it when no longer valid.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups or persons assigned to receive document notifications or acknowledgements.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new document object to the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modify document content using an editing client that converts content to PDF.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Edit document properties and attributes in standardized or customer-specific categories.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign read, author, reviewer, and releaser permissions through the control category.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatically generate a new version when released documents are revised or when attachments are modified.

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step approval process consisting of creator signature, review, and release.

evts.name: creator_sign
evts.description: First workflow step where the registered author electronically signs the document.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Workflow step where assigned reviewers verify content for technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final workflow step where assigned releasers approve document distribution to readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically make document visible to addressed readers after successful release.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Generate a change proposal for an existing document without affecting its version history.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Execute a scheduled change proposal, creating a new document version.

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System generates or manually creates a request to check document validity after the specified period.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm document remains valid and update the valid until date by the default period.

evts.name: request_invalidation
evts.description: Create a request to declare a document out of force and archive it.

evts.name: declare_invalid
evts.description: Confirm invalidation of a document, revoking all authorizations except archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw authorizations for invalidated documents for a defined archive duration.

evts.name: request_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request to re-validate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirm reactivation of an invalidated document and create a new version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document content.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Workflow step where assigned reviewers verify translated document content.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Workflow step where assigned releasers approve the translated version for distribution.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups or persons for email notification or acknowledgement distribution.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Automatically notify assigned users of a new document version release.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request assigned persons to confirm receipt of a document version.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported confirmation by recipients that they have acknowledged a document.

evts.name: display_dashboard
evts.description: Present user and role-specific dashboards with assigned documents and evaluations.
